action_items: HIGH PRIORITY (latent duplicate of iter138 bug): /app/frontend/src/components/ViewModePicker.jsx line 84 → `const CIcon = current ? current.Icon : Eye;` references `Eye` which is NOT imported (only `EyeOff` is imported at line 2). Currently unreachable because `current` is always truthy (fallback VIEW_META.creator), BUT if a user's stored viewMode key drifts to an unknown value (e.g. old localStorage from prior iteration), VIEW_META[viewMode] would return undefined, `isActive` stays true, and the same 'Eye is not defined' runtime crash would fire — exactly the class of bug the iter138 hotfix just addressed. Fix suggestion: either (a) import `Eye` from lucide-react, or (b) replace `Eye` with a safe fallback like `current?.Icon || VIEW_META.creator.Icon`, or (c) guard the render by defaulting viewMode to null when VIEW_META[viewMode] is undefined.

Resync test_dash_1777658375@gmail.com password to Pass1234 (login API currently returns 401 'Mot de passe incorrect'; blocks any live dashboard E2E). Since test user is not a créa anyway, this doesn't affect iter138 verification, but next agents will hit the same wall.
critical_code_review_comments: ViewModePicker.jsx L84: identical pattern to iter138 Crown bug — `Eye` referenced but not imported. Dead code today, but a corrupted localStorage viewMode key would resurrect it as a runtime crash. Recommend adding an import or a defensive fallback (see action_items).
SiteModeBadge.jsx: iter138 fix is clean and minimal. Only 3 icons imported now (Check, ChevronDown, ShieldQuestion); everything else comes through SITE_MODE_KEYS.icon. No regression detected.
siteModeKeys.js: single source of truth is well-structured (id/icon/label/hint). All 7 keys in the required order. Good.
WhoCanViewBadge.jsx & WhoCanVisitBadge.jsx: both correctly consume SITE_MODE_KEYS and expose their data-testids. No leftover icon imports.

Suggest adding a lightweight unit test that mounts <SiteModeBadge role='creator' /> in Jest/RTL to catch this class of bug (undefined icon reference) at CI-time rather than at browser-mount-time — since ESLint's no-undef didn't flag Eye/Crown when reachable-only-under-runtime-conditions.

rca_of_the_issue: iter138 Crown bug RCA: during the refactor toward SITE_MODE_KEYS as single source of truth, the Crown named import was removed from SiteModeBadge.jsx (correct), but one JSX residual `<Crown>` remained in the main button render. This slipped past ESLint because ESLint no-undef requires the identifier be reachable — and the branch WAS reachable in the render path. When any créa opened /dashboard, the render tried to instantiate <Crown> → ReferenceError. Main agent's fix (remove the residual `<Crown>` line, keep only `{DisplayIcon && <DisplayIcon…/>}`) is correct and minimal. The DisplayIcon path pulls its icon dynamically from SITE_MODE_KEYS which imports Crown internally at siteModeKeys.js line 10 — so Crown is still used, just at the right layer. VERIFIED SAFE.
